title: feat(ui): extract remaining website v2 components and styles
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Extracts the remaining shared UI from #14472: chat components, headers, uploads, menus, model controls, icons, fonts and theme styles. No website pages or backend changes.
- Moves Markdown/Prose to `@pollinations/ui/markdown` and updates both existing gallery imports.
- Preserves the newer account-menu reuse on main. Removes duplicated tab styling and fixes native accessibility labels and disabled tab links.
- Verified: 47 UI tests, SDK/UI builds, UI/gallery typechecks, gallery production build, and browser checks for light/dark themes, Markdown, dropdowns and dialogs.
- Follows #14843; keeps the remaining library extraction in one PR.

gist.headline: The UI gets a hive mind
gist.blurb: The remaining website v2 building blocks have moved into the shared UI library: chat, uploads, menus, model controls, Markdown, icons, fonts, and theme pieces. Less copied styling wandering between apps; more components knowing where they live.
gist.summary: Extracted the remaining website v2 chat, header, upload, menu, model-control, icon, font, theme, and Markdown components into @pollinations/ui, including a new @pollinations/ui/markdown entrypoint used by both gallery imports.
gist.impact: Pollinations surfaces now share consistent light/dark theming, account menus, accessible tab labels and disabled links, and reusable UI behavior that can be maintained and improved in one place.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful librarian or builder organizing many small shared interface blocks—chat bubbles, upload tray, dropdown menu, model-control dial, Markdown page, icons, and theme swatches—into one cozy modular garden shed labeled UI. Code-plants growing from the component trays represent reuse, while a CRT monitor robot happily connects the modules; the scene should communicate that scattered website pieces now belong to one friendly shared library.
